DOP: caccara n. [ BHS, AMg id.; cf S. carcara, None K.R. Norman, 1960, p. 268; and S. catvara, BHS catvāra], a square (where several roads meet); a thoroughfare ; Abh 203 (catukkaṃ ~e); 218 (ajiraṃ caccarāṅganaṃ); Vin IV 271, 7 (siṅghāṭako nāma ~aṃ vuccati); Ap 43, 19 (siṅghāṭakaṃ ~aṃ ca suvibhattantarāpaṇaṃ kārayeyya; Ap-a 284, 21 : siṅghāṭakaṃ catumaggasandhiṃ ca ~aṃ antarāvīthiṃ ca kāraye); 44, 9 (paññā te ~aṃ mune; Ap-a 286, 6 : paññā ~aṃ maggasamodhānaṃ nagaravīthī ti attho); Mil 1, 20 (nagaraṃ … suvibhattavīthicaccara-catukkasiṅghāṭakaṃ); — ifc see rathiyā-.
NCP: neuter a courtyard; a cross road; a thoroughfare.
